summary: Orion Digital Corp. (formerly Mogo Inc.), a Vancouver-based foreign private issuer listed on NASDAQ/TSX, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q3 2026 results press release dated November 5, 2026. Neither a transaction nor a structural event is disclosed: Adjusted EBITDA rose 35% year-to-date to $7.5 million on revenue of $73 million, Q3 revenue was $17.0 million flat year-over-year, operating cash flow was $2.5 million, and $4.3 million of debt was repaid. Full-year Adjusted EBITDA guidance was raised to $7.0-8.0 million. No board recommendation, advisor, price, stake or regulatory clock applies; the filing is a routine earnings disclosure, so no risk-arb angle exists.
